metadata.title: Software project specification
metadata.description: Confirm intent, constraints, and delivery expectations before execution.

tabs.label: Intent
tabs.description: Define the outcome and the evidence that will count as success.

fields.label: Primary objective
fields.description: State the concrete result the project should produce.
fields.placeholder: What should exist or work when this project is complete?

assistance.prompt: Offer precise, outcome-oriented alternatives without inventing scope.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: List observable checks that establish completion.

assistance.prompt: Suggest measurable acceptance criteria grounded in the stated objective.

fields.label: Explicit exclusions
fields.description: Record work that should not be included.

tabs.label: Constraints
tabs.description: Confirm the operating environment and consequential technical boundaries.

options.label: macOS
options.implications: Account for application bundle and browser conventions.

fields.label: Distribution method
fields.rationale: Source installation is the least assumptive starting point.

options.label: Source checkout
options.implications: Fastest development path; users manage the runtime.

options.label: Language package
options.implications: Requires package metadata and release automation.

options.label: Standalone binary
options.implications: Requires platform builds and larger release artifacts.

assistance.prompt: Compare distribution choices for the selected platforms.

tabs.label: Delivery
tabs.description: Define expected artifacts and verification depth.

fields.label: Required deliverables
fields.value: Working implementation, automated tests, and usage documentation
fields.rationale: These are the minimum durable project outputs.

options.label: Unit tests
options.implications: Fast but does not prove the assembled workflow.

options.label: Unit and integration tests
options.implications: Exercises component boundaries and main workflows.

options.label: Full end-to-end verification
options.implications: Includes a real browser and representative user journey.
